scope: Actual visual review of seven second-candidate still images; no animation or video-quality claim.
pendingMaterialCorrection: Soldier Field turf uses masonry pattern10; change to grass pattern4 and inspect a fresh bowl proof.

images.observation: Generic stadium slab and side blocks are absent. Historic porticos, open understructure, silver/glass east crescent and taller west seating bank are readable.
Field, yard lines, end zones, discrete inward-facing seats and radial aisles are unobstructed. Remaining defect: masonry-like joints across the turf from material pattern10.

Warm courtesy strips identify several occupied nearby boats; two-sided dock pools and short reflections are clearer. Most unoccupied boats and rigging remain dark, consistent with a restrained moored-marina treatment.
The former bright triangular land wedge over Lake Michigan is absent. Shoreline meets open water continuously in the upper-right background.
Mapped finger rows, water and representative sailboats/motorboats are visible. The harbor office and visitor facilities now have low-rise proportions rather than tall generic blocks.
Dock pools, selected occupied cabins and shoreline/city lights establish the marina at night. The unlit foreground remains dark; boat occupancy is deliberately a subset.
Classical portico columns receive subdued warm illumination. The suite facade and portions of the upper aisles remain readable; no generic stadium slab is visible.

limits: 1280x800 stills do not establish motion quality, temporal stability or full walkthrough coverage.
Harbor nighttime design is an interpreted calm marina; no calibrated photometric survey or live berth occupancy.
Generic buildings remain simplified and some map heights are estimated.
